name: Siren
description: A plug-in siren with a 115 dB siren and a 100 dB chime. Insteon sensors and controllers trigger it when it's armed, and keypads and remotes arm and disarm it, in home mode, away mode or both.

verification.note: The Siren Module Developer Notes give 0x03 as its get engine version reply in their text and 0x02 in their table and example.
The Siren Module Developer Notes' introduction swaps home and away for groups 1 to 4; their group table, used here, doesn't.

notes: As a controller, group 1 is the alert: it broadcasts while the siren sounds.
The LED is green when the siren is armed and red when it's disarmed.
The siren alert sounds for 2 minutes by default, unless the siren is disarmed.
The Siren Module Developer Notes' example broadcasts carry another product's category and subcategory.
